title: ComplexUi: the existing 83-control scene, clean and dirty frames
scenario: Samples/ComplexUi/ComplexUiScene.h: 16 cards (label, toggle, slider, progress bar), a Tree and a Grid over a 1,000-row model, absolute layout, offscreen EmbeddedHost, reduced motion; 20 warm-up frames, 40 clean frames, 40 dirty frames.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: ComplexUiScene::Update(n): first-use resources and caches settle

phases.name: clean
phases.description: nothing changes: prepare and composite only

phases.name: dirty
phases.description: ComplexUiScene::Update(20 + n): 16 slider and progress values and the Grid's visible row change

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX5 -Variant default -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost embedded -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
